question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

To move about from place to place aimlessly
solution:
The correct answer is** ****"Meander."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "meander"** means (used about a person or animal) to walk or travel slowly or without any definite direction, To wander aimlessly or casually, often taking a winding or indirect path. (मंद गति से चलना या निरुद्देश्‍य घूमना-फिरना)

 
 
• **Example**:* The river **meandered**__ through the valley, creating a picturesque landscape.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word** "meander"** means to move about from place to place aimlessly.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Path: **a way across a piece of land that is made by or used by people walking. (पगडंडी, रास्‍ता)
 
• **Meadow: **a field of grass. (घास का मैदान, घास स्‍थली)
 
• **Stream: **(used about a liquid, gas or light) to flow in large amounts. ((द्रव, गैस या प्रकाश की) धारा फूटना)
